_comment: Performance budgets (issue #35). Query budgets are milliseconds, the median of 7 runs after one warm-up, on the seeded association in tests/association_seed.py. Bundle budgets are gzipped kilobytes of web/dist/assets. Change a budget only with a recorded reason in docs/performance-budgets.md. Page budgets (issue #30) are the summed median of a page's server calls, measured by scripts/check-page-budget.py.
